Messages.Author: Michael Beer
Messages.Body:
It is probably a dumb question:

A Ghoul Retainer can use a weapon its minion is not using the current
round of combat.

Can GR use a RPG Launcher during the FIRST round of combat or at close
range, ignoring the weapon restrictions?

I think no, but I find the question worthy to ask (there are so much
whacky clarifications and errata).

Michael Beer

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <3507B232...@leila.ping.de>,


No. The Ghoul "uses" the weapon - and the weapon has explicit restrictions
on when it can be used (not on first round, only at long range).
